LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.InstantWallTooltip: Makes smoothing effectively instant. Default off because this is a cheat-style option.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.InstantFloorTooltip: Makes floor smoothing effectively instant. Requires Harmony. Default: off.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.SpeedExplanation: Vanilla is 1x. The default for this mod is 2x. Construction skill, manipulation, sight, and global work speed still apply normally.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.FloorSpeedHarmony: Harmony: enables a separate floor speed. Without it, floors use the wall speed.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.OverrideNaturalWallWea: Detected vanilla smoothed walls use the value selected below.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.OverrideNaturalFloorWe: Experimental: override vanilla smoothed-floor wealth (default: off)
Adjusts RimWorld's cached floor-wealth total after a recount. May conflict with mods that alter map wealth, raid wealth, or floor valuation.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.RequiresHarmonyTooltip: Requires Harmony. Wall speed and wall wealth remain available without it.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.FloorWealthWarning: Experimental; leave off for maximum compatibility. When off, the adjustment is skipped entirely.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.RemoveNaturalWallBeaut: Detected vanilla smoothed walls use the value selected below. Applies immediately; no Harmony required.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.RemoveNaturalFloorBeau: Detected vanilla smoothed floors use the value selected below. Applies immediately; no Harmony required.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.EnableChunkConstructio: Enable chunk-built smoothed walls and floors (restart required)
Adds chunk-built smoothed walls and floors for Core stone, plus Vacstone with Odyssey. Each tile costs one matching raw chunk. Architect entries are hidden while disabled.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.DisableChunkWarning: Chunk-built construction has been switched off. Existing chunk-built surfaces remain in the save. Before uninstalling, use 'Prepare loaded save for uninstall' to convert them and cancel unfinished construction.\n\nContinue with chunk-built construction disabled?
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.UninstallWarning: Vanilla-result surfaces are uninstall-safe. Deconstructible walls and removable floors must be converted before removing this mod.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkResultConstructed: Chunk-built: deconstructible walls and removable floors (default)
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkResultNatural: Vanilla: mineable walls and permanent floors
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.NaturalResultExplanati: Vanilla-result construction consumes one chunk and the normal work, then becomes a genuine vanilla smoothed surface. Walls are mineable; floors are permanent. Both remain if this mod is removed.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkWallWealthTooltip: When enabled, all chunk-built walls use the value selected below. When disabled, each uses its corresponding stone-block wall value.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkFloorWealthToolti: When enabled, all chunk-built floors use the value selected below. When disabled, each uses its corresponding stone-floor value.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkWallBeautyTooltip: When enabled, all chunk-built walls use the value selected below. When disabled, each matches its corresponding vanilla smoothed wall.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkFloorBeautyToolti: When enabled, all chunk-built floors use the value selected below. When disabled, each matches its corresponding vanilla smoothed floor.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ChunkConstructionExpla: No research required. Each tile costs one matching raw chunk and uses normal stone wall or floor construction work.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.UninstallExplanation: Converts completed chunk-built walls and floors into their vanilla smoothed counterparts. It also cancels unfinished blueprints and frames, returning delivered resources. Vanilla-result surfaces need no conversion.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.LoadSaveTooltip: Load a save first. Conversion operates on all maps currently held by that save.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ResetWarning: Resetting all settings will disable chunk-built construction. If this save contains completed custom surfaces or unfinished construction, cancel and use 'Prepare loaded save for uninstall' first.\n\nReset all settings anyway?
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.HomeIntroduction: Choose a page to adjust smoothing, surface overrides, or chunk construction. Save conversion is intentionally kept on its own page.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilityFloorSpeedAv: Separate floor smoothing speed: available through Harmony.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilityFloorSpeedUn: Separate floor smoothing speed: unavailable; floors use the wall settings without Harmony.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilityFloorWealthA: Floor wealth overrides: available through Harmony.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilityFloorWealthU: Floor wealth overrides: unavailable without Harmony.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilitySaveLoaded: Loaded save: save-preparation tools are available.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.CapabilityNoSaveLoaded: No loaded save: save-preparation tools are unavailable.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ResetChunkWarning: Resetting chunk-construction settings will disable chunk-built construction. If this save contains completed custom surfaces or unfinished construction, cancel and use 'Prepare loaded save for uninstall' first.\n\nReset chunk-construction settings anyway?
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.SaveSafetyIntroduction: These tools can change the loaded save. Back up the save before continuing.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ConversionNeedsSave: Load a save before converting chunk-built surfaces.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ConversionWarning: Convert every chunk-built smoothed wall and floor on all loaded maps?\n\nWalls become mineable vanilla smoothed walls. Floors become permanent vanilla smoothed floors. Unfinished blueprints and frames are cancelled and delivered resources returned. This cannot be reversed automatically. Save a backup first.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ConversionReport: Conversion complete: {0} floor tile(s) and {1} wall(s) converted on {2} loaded map(s); {3} unfinished blueprint/frame(s) cancelled. Chunk-construction settings were reset to defaults; restart to update Architect visibility. Save before removing the mod.
LanguageData.SmoothingExpanded.ConversionIncomplete: Uninstall preparation is incomplete: {0} custom surface(s) remain in the save. Chunk-construction settings were not reset. Do not remove the mod; check the error log and retry.
